description: This source file is a shell script used for testing the 'git patch-id' functionality within a git project. It defines test procedures, setup steps, and verification methods to ensure the patch-id computation is correct across various scenarios.

methods.name: calc_patch_id
methods.description: Calculates the patch ID for a given patch name, ensures the output is well-formed and contains a single line.

methods.name: get_top_diff
methods.description: Retrieves the top diff from the latest git log for a specified revision.

methods.name: get_patch_id
methods.description: Gets the patch ID for a specified revision by retrieving the top diff and computing its patch ID.
